{
  "candidate_rtl": "module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire inv_a;
    wire inv_b;
    wire sub;
    wire [63:0] ax;
    wire [63:0] bx;
    wire [63:0] base_xor;
    wire [63:0] sum_prop;
    wire [63:0] carry_prop;
    wire [63:0] bit_gen;
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_result;
    wire [15:0] group_prop;
    wire [15:0] group_gen;
    wire [15:0] prefix_p [0:4];
    wire [15:0] prefix_g [0:4];
    wire [16:0] block_carry;
    wire en_arithmetic;
    wire en_or;
    wire en_and;
    wire en_xor;
    wire en_xnor;

    assign inv_a = Oper[1];
    assign inv_b = Oper[0];
    assign sub = Oper[1] | Oper[0];
    assign ax = a ^ {64{inv_a}};
    assign bx = b ^ {64{inv_b}};
    assign base_xor = a ^ b;
    assign sum_prop = base_xor ^ {64{sub}};
    assign carry_prop = ax | bx;
    assign bit_gen = ax & bx;
    assign block_carry[0] = sub;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin : blocks
            wire c1;
            wire c2;
            wire c3;

            assign group_prop[k] = &carry_prop[4*k +: 4];
            assign group_gen[k] = bit_gen[4*k+3]
                | (carry_prop[4*k+3] & bit_gen[4*k+2])
                | (carry_prop[4*k+3] & carry_prop[4*k+2]
                   & bit_gen[4*k+1])
                | (carry_prop[4*k+3] & carry_prop[4*k+2]
                   & carry_prop[4*k+1] & bit_gen[4*k]);

            assign prefix_p[0][k] = group_prop[k];
            if (k == 0) begin : first_group
                assign prefix_g[0][k] = group_gen[k]
                    | (group_prop[k] & sub);
            end else begin : later_group
                assign prefix_g[0][k] = group_gen[k];
            end
            assign block_carry[k+1] = prefix_g[4][k];

            assign c1 = bit_gen[4*k]
                | (carry_prop[4*k] & block_carry[k]);
            assign c2 = bit_gen[4*k+1]
                | (carry_prop[4*k+1] & bit_gen[4*k])
                | (carry_prop[4*k+1] & carry_prop[4*k]
                   & block_carry[k]);
            assign c3 = bit_gen[4*k+2]
                | (carry_prop[4*k+2] & bit_gen[4*k+1])
                | (carry_prop[4*k+2] & carry_prop[4*k+1]
                   & bit_gen[4*k])
                | (carry_prop[4*k+2] & carry_prop[4*k+1]
                   & carry_prop[4*k] & block_carry[k]);

            if (k == 0) begin : first_sum_bit
                assign arithmetic_result[4*k] = base_xor[4*k];
            end else begin : other_sum_bits
                assign arithmetic_result[4*k] = sum_prop[4*k]
                    ^ block_carry[k];
            end
            assign arithmetic_result[4*k+1] = sum_prop[4*k+1] ^ c1;
            assign arithmetic_result[4*k+2] = sum_prop[4*k+2] ^ c2;
            assign arithmetic_result[4*k+3] = sum_prop[4*k+3] ^ c3;
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar level;
    genvar column;
    generate
        for (level = 0; level < 4; level = level + 1) begin : prefix_levels
            for (column = 0; column < 16; column = column + 1) begin : columns
                if (column >= (1 << level)) begin : combine
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][column] =
                        prefix_g[level][column]
                        | (prefix_p[level][column]
                           & prefix_g[level][column-(1 << level)]);
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][column] =
                        prefix_p[level][column]
                        & prefix_p[level][column-(1 << level)];
                end else begin : pass_through
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][column] = prefix_g[level][column];
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][column] = prefix_p[level][column];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign en_arithmetic = ~Oper[2] & ~(Oper[1] & Oper[0]);
    assign en_or = (Oper == 3'b011);
    assign en_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    assign en_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    assign en_xnor = (Oper == 3'b110);

    always @(*) begin
        sum = ({64{en_arithmetic}} & arithmetic_result)
            | ({64{en_or}} & (a | b))
            | ({64{en_and}} & (a & b))
            | ({64{en_xor}} & base_xor)
            | ({64{en_xnor}} & ~base_xor);
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The likely baseline critical path is carry propagation through a 64-bit arithmetic operation followed by operation selection. Three independently expressed arithmetic operations also consume area that could otherwise support faster carry logic.",
  "rewrite": "Share one conditional-complement adder across addition and both subtraction directions. Use four-bit lookahead groups, a four-level parallel-prefix network across the sixteen groups, and parallel local carry equations. Absorb the initial carry into the first group's generate term. Use mutually exclusive output masks for arithmetic and logical operations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit carry network replaces potentially long mapped carry chains with logarithmic inter-group propagation. A meaningful reduction in maximum arrival is expected if carry propagation dominates the baseline; no numerical gain is claimed without running the specified mapping and timing flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Sharing arithmetic removes two independent arithmetic datapaths, while the prefix network adds carry-generation logic and routing fanout. This is intended to leave room under the 13098.437440 um^2 cap, but mapped area, electrical violations, and timing remain unverified.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module interface and unsigned 64-bit outputs for every two-state input. Operations 000, 001, and 010 implement a+b, a-b, and b-a modulo 2^64; 011 through 110 retain their original logical functions; 111 produces zero. Internal arithmetic values for non-arithmetic opcodes are masked off. The original unobservable c_out is omitted. No storage, latency, assumptions, or external dependencies are introduced."
}
